card.name: Words leading up to dosing interval
card.fires_on: Small words right after verbs like extend, increase or lengthen, just before a word such as interval, time between doses or rest period. It marks the spot where a gap or spacing term is expected next.

modes.label: Lengthening the interval
modes.description: Word after extend or increase, just before 'dosing interval' or 'time intervals between doses'.
modes.example: Reduce the daily dosage by increasing<< the>> dosing interval; monitor renal function.

modes.label: Longest possible rest period
modes.description: The word 'possible' after 'longest', before 'rest period' in dose reduction advice.
modes.example: the dosage should be reduced to the lowest possible amount of drug and to the longest<< possible>> rest period.

modes.label: Minimum time apart
modes.description: Word in 'at least X hours apart' phrasing about spacing between doses.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict interval, gap and spacing words next.
